display.purpose: Page headings and main section titles.

body.purpose: All prose, form labels, and primary content.

label.purpose: Time labels, calendar headers, metadata, and technical indicators.

shadows.name: card-elevation
shadows.purpose: Default card and container shadow—barely there, just enough to separate from background.

shadows.name: elevated-surface
shadows.purpose: Modals, dropdowns, and hovered elements. Clear lift but still diffuse.

motion.name: spring-standard
motion.purpose: Spring animation for button presses and interactive elements.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action button with indigo background and spring hover animation.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 14px 24px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: white; background: #3e4c7a; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; overflow: hidden; transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(62, 76, 122, 0.2), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2d3954; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(62, 76, 122, 0.3), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(62, 76, 122, 0.2), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(62, 76, 122, 0.3), 0 2px 8px rgba(62, 76, 122, 0.2); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Standard text input with border transition on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 10px 14px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; color: #1a1c23; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #d0cdc5; border-radius: 4px; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8a8c94; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #b0aca3; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #3e4c7a; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(62, 76, 122, 0.3); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; background: #f0efe9; }

components.name: Calendar Event
components.description: Calendar booking event with gradient background and left accent border.
components.css: .ds-calendar-event { cursor: pointer; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(62, 76, 122, 0.25), rgba(62, 76, 122, 0.15)); border: none; border-left: 3px solid #3e4c7a; border-radius: 2px; padding: 8px 12px; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(62, 76, 122, 0.1); transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1); position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-calendar-event:hover { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(62, 76, 122, 0.35), rgba(62, 76, 122, 0.2)); border-left-color: #2d3954; transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.01); box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(62, 76, 122, 0.15); } .ds-calendar-event::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 4px; right: 4px; width: 4px; height: 4px; background: #7a8b6d; border-radius: 50%; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.2s ease; } .ds-calendar-event:hover::before { opacity: 1; } .ds-event-time { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #1a1c23; } .ds-event-title { font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.8rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: #1a1c23; }

components.name: Card Container
components.description: White card with subtle elevation for content grouping.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border-radius: 6px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(58, 62, 74, 0.04), 0 4px 12px rgba(58, 62, 74, 0.03); transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(58, 62, 74, 0.06), 0 12px 32px rgba(58, 62, 74, 0.04); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 500; color: #1a1c23; margin: 0 0 8px 0; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #585a63; line-height: 1.6; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview: A professional booking system built on clarity, efficiency, and quiet confidence. The visual language speaks through restraint rather than decoration—every element earns its place through function, not ornament. The Japanese Industrial color palette brings warmth without sacrificing professionalism, while the typography hierarchy creates clear information architecture at a glance. This system rejects the dated, bureaucratic aesthetic of traditional scheduling software.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet confidence: Professional but approachable, formal but warm
Information-first: Typography and spacing guide the eye before decoration
Restraint: One primary accent (indigo) used deliberately
Motion with purpose: Spring animations on interactions, not gratuitous transitions

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: The primary indigo appears on ≤15% of any screen. Its rarity creates visual hierarchy.

rules.name: The Mono Label Rule
rules.body: Time, dates, and metadata always use JetBrains Mono with uppercase tracking.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rest flat. Shadows are a response to interaction, not a default styling choice.

rules.name: The Warmth-Without-Heat Rule
rules.body: The cream background provides warmth, but the overall temperature remains cool-to-neutral.

dos: Use ≥7:1 contrast for all body text against its background (WCAG AAA)
Use JetBrains Mono for all time labels, calendar headers, and metadata
Add spring animations to interactive elements (0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1 curve)
Use cream background for main page surface and white for cards/containers
Keep motion subtle—scale max 1.02, translations max -2px
donts: Use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe
Use gradient text—use solid colors with weight/size for emphasis
Add identical card grids repeating endlessly
Add tiny uppercase tracked eyebrows above every section
Let text overflow its container—test clamp() values at narrow viewports
Make the interface look dated or bureaucratic
Use the saturated warm-tint monoculture (cream/sand/paper at OKLCH L 0.84-0.97)
